Terms of service

Last updated: November 4, 2026

These terms are an agreement between you and SideQuest (“SideQuest”, “we”, “us”), operated from Ontario, Canada, for your use of the SideQuest website and app. By creating an account you agree to them. If you don’t agree, please don’t use SideQuest.

1. Your account

You need to be at least 16 years old and give a valid email address that you control. Keep your password secure; you’re responsible for activity in your account. Tell us at support@your-domain.com if you think someone else has accessed it.

2. Your content

You own everything you put into SideQuest. You give us permission to store, copy and display it only as needed to provide the service to you. You can export it at any time from the app.

3. Plans

  • Free: up to 3 active projects, with no charge.
  • Pro: unlimited active projects plus progress and income reports, for US$9 per month or US$72 per year.

Prices are in US dollars. Applicable sales taxes, such as HST, are added where required and shown at checkout. If you move from Pro back to Free, every project you have stays in your account; you just can’t add more than 3 active ones.

4. Billing and renewal

Pro is paid in advance through our payment processor, Stripe, and renews automatically at the end of each monthly or yearly period, charging the payment method on file, until you cancel. We’ll email you a reminder before a yearly plan renews. We may change prices with at least 30 days’ notice by email; a new price applies from your next renewal after the notice, and you can cancel before then.

If a payment fails, Stripe will retry it for a short period while Pro stays active. If it still can’t be collected, your account moves to the Free plan.

5. Cancelling

Cancel any time with Manage billing in the app, or by emailing us. You keep Pro until the end of the period you’ve paid for, and you won’t be charged again.

6. Refunds

If you’re not happy, email support@your-domain.com within 14 days of any charge, first payment or renewal, and we’ll refund that charge in full to the original payment method. Pro ends when the refund is issued. After 14 days, charges aren’t refundable except where the law requires.

7. Acceptable use

Don’t misuse SideQuest. That includes trying to access other people’s accounts or data, probing or disrupting the service, sending automated traffic that overloads it, or using it for anything unlawful. We may suspend or close accounts that do, and will tell you why unless the law or safety prevents it.

8. Availability and backups

We work to keep SideQuest available and your data safe, but we can’t promise it will always be available or error-free. We recommend downloading a backup from the app from time to time. We may change or improve features; if we ever shut SideQuest down, we’ll give at least 30 days’ notice so you can export your data, and refund any unused prepaid period.

9. Liability

SideQuest is provided “as is”. To the extent the law allows, we aren’t liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer that can’t be limited under the law, including Ontario’s Consumer Protection Act.

10. Ending your account

You can delete your account at any time with Delete account in the app footer. This removes your account and workspace and cancels any subscription. Our privacy policy explains what happens to your information.

11. Changes to these terms

If we make material changes, we’ll email you at least 30 days before they take effect. Continuing to use SideQuest after that means you accept the new terms; if you don’t, you can cancel and request a refund of any unused prepaid period.

12. Governing law and contact

These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there. Questions: support@your-domain.com.
